# Colderby Freight - August crates

The grower settles freight per vehicle, counting crates delivered and crediting the empties each van brings back; empties/august-2026.csv lists them under that van.

turns.prompt: Colderby Freight settles its grower contract vehicle by vehicle, counting the crates a van delivers and crediting the empties it brings back. How many crates did the Stoat deliver in August 2026 once empties are credited?
The Dale Stoat. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
